newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn offers slip, soy, wheat flat.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn offers slip, soy, wheat flat.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn offers slipped one to two cents a bushel on Thursday while soybean and wheat values were steady, export sources said.

One U.S. exporter noted that FOB corn values were under pressure from competition. "Argentine corn is cheaper than ours. Although our (weekly) export sales were good for both corn and soybeans. it has been pretty quiet," the exporter said.
"You might see some movement for corn in the Pacific Northwest. If corn was going to Asia, it is definitely cheaper going by PNW," the exporter added.
Dealers were also monitoring the situation on the Mississippi River in southern Louisiana.
Since Monday afternoon, three separate incidents have closed the river at locations from Baton Rouge to the Gulf of Mexico.
The U.S. Coast Guard and other officials blamed the traffic snarls at least in part on high water on the river, which created additional currents and moved tons of silt downriver from the Midwest.
